body: Job 2167 correctness: Automatic reviewer-rejection routing was removed at skills/first-officer/references/first-officer-shared-core.md:81. A feedback gate whose reviewer recommends REJECTED now reaches captain presentation instead of following the documented automatic rejection loop. The live test masks this by explicitly directing the first officer to route the rejection. Fix: restore the reviewer-REJECTED branch before the captain-decision lifecycle and test it with a goal-only prompt.

Job 2167 correctness: Captain decisions do not map to persisted decisions at skills/fo-gate-lifecycle/SKILL.md:29. The captain-facing choices are approve, redo, and reject, but the recorder accepts approve, revise, and hold. Without an explicit mapping, reject may produce an invalid command or erase the distinction between redo and rejection. Fix: define the mapping or extend the persisted decision schema, then add behavioral coverage for every captain-facing decision.

Job 2167 correctness: The live test duplicates the shipped lifecycle instructions at internal/ensigncycle/recorded_gate_lifecycle_test.go:692. The scenario prompt specifies the full procedure, allowing the test to remain green even if those instructions disappear from the lifecycle skill. Fix: restrict the prompt to the goal, fixture, and delegated authority, rely on the shipped skill for procedure, and retain the durable command/state oracle.

Job 2167 correctness: Review extraction can accept subagent-only output at internal/ensigncycle/recorded_gate_lifecycle_test.go:765. The Claude review extractor scans every assistant row without checking parent_tool_use_id, so a subagent can satisfy the expected fields even if the root never presents them to the captain. Fix: parse row metadata and accept review text only from top-level assistant messages.
